title: Two tenant counsel grants budgeted $432,708 above their share of one office

beats.text: Two City grants supported tenant lawyers at 976 Mission Street.

visual.sub: Two budgets for one Mission Street office

beats.text: The budgets included $423,233 for rent alone.

visual.kicker: Two budgets for one Mission Street office

beats.text: The housing department calculated the program’s share using occupied floor space.

visual.line: Office space used by each program

beats.text: It put the combined share at $412,000.

visual.label: The budgets exceeded the program’s share by $432,708

beats.text: The budget analyst found a difference of $432,708.

visual.label: The budgets exceeded the program’s share by $432,708

beats.text: The department said it would revise the budgets. The analyst recommended approval.

visual.kicker: The budgets exceeded the program’s share by $432,708

beats.text: In January the supervisors authorized the larger grant.

visual.kicker: The amendment reached the Board in the seventh month

beats.text: The previous year, 455 tenants received full representation.

visual.label: Service outcomes and the provider’s response

beats.text: That exceeded the service target of 407.

visual.label: Service outcomes and the provider’s response

beats.text: Two payment registers agree on what the City paid across both contracts.
